shell.title: MockLogistics Sandbox
shell.subtitle: MOCK LOGISTICS PLATFORM
shell.footer: For local integration only. It simulates merchant outbound, transit, delivery, and signed callbacks without storefront business modules.

auth.title: MockLogistics operator sign-in
auth.description: Use the configured MockLogistics operator credentials for this sandbox.
auth.invalidCredentials: The username or password is incorrect.

console.title: Mock logistics platform
console.description: Create shipments, confirm merchant outbound, then watch pickup, transit, delivery, and completion advance automatically. Manual controls can move faster.

create.title: Create shipment
create.description: The merchant order number is idempotent. Missing receiver, city, carrier, and item fields are generated with gofakeit.

lookup.title: Look up a shipment
lookup.description: Enter the shipment number returned by create to inspect its status, timeline, and callbacks.
lookup.label: Shipment number

guide.title: Sandbox workflow

create.title: Create a shipment
create.description: Generate the shipment number, tracking number, carrier, and sender/receiver details. The initial status is pending outbound.

pickup.title: Merchant outbound
pickup.description: A merchant must confirm outbound from the detail page before pickup can begin.

advance.title: Automatic progression
advance.description: After merchant outbound, the sandbox advances through pickup, transit, hub, and delivery within the configured window (4 minutes by default), then signs automatically. Manual actions can move faster.

guide.isolation: MockLogistics uses its own tables, /mocklogistics routes, and frontend folder. It does not call the storefront order, payment, or inventory modules.

form.merchantOrderNoHint: Replays with the same merchant order number must use an identical payload.
form.itemSummaryHint: Leave blank to generate with gofakeit.
form.carrierHint: Leave blank to choose a common carrier automatically.
form.cityHint: Leave blank to generate distinct origin and destination cities.
form.receiverHint: Receiver fields may be blank and are filled with gofakeit.
form.notifyURLHint: The built-in receiver is used by default. Replace it when integrating another service.
form.autofillHint: Blank fields use gofakeit to produce more realistic mock data.

validation.merchantOrderNoLength: Merchant order number must be 64 characters or fewer
validation.itemSummaryLength: Item summary must be 200 characters or fewer
validation.carrierLength: Carrier must be 64 characters or fewer
validation.cityLength: City must be 64 characters or fewer
validation.receiverNameLength: Receiver must be 100 characters or fewer
validation.receiverPhoneLength: Receiver phone must be 32 characters or fewer
validation.receiverAddressLength: Receiver address must be 500 characters or fewer
validation.notifyLength: Notification URL must be 2048 characters or fewer
validation.notifyInvalid: Notification URL must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL

actions.title: Shipment actions
actions.description: Statuses advance automatically after outbound. Manual actions can move faster.
actions.outboundHint: Confirm outbound after the merchant releases the parcel from the warehouse.
actions.advanceHint: Advance immediately instead of waiting for the next automatic step.
actions.completeHint: Delivery completes automatically at the end of the window; confirm to finish now.
actions.terminalHint: This shipment is complete and cannot advance further.

fields.title: Shipment details
fields.description: These values come directly from the mock logistics API.

parties.title: Sender and receiver
parties.description: Blank values are generated by gofakeit.

timeline.title: Tracking timeline
timeline.description: Each automatic or manual change writes an event and triggers a signed callback.

notifications.title: Callback delivery
notifications.description: Every status change creates a signed notification. Failures use a backoff schedule.
notifications.empty: A callback appears here after merchant outbound.

errors.network: Cannot reach the mock logistics service. Check that the backend is running.
errors.invalidRequest: The request is invalid. Check the form values.
errors.duplicateOrder: This merchant order number already exists with a different payload.
errors.invalidTransition: The shipment cannot perform this action in its current state.
errors.server: The mock logistics service is unavailable.
errors.notificationNotRetryable: Only exhausted notifications can be retried.
errors.loadNotifications: Refresh the callback history and try again.
